purpose: Phase-6D tumour-response evidence records. The B16BL6 records are grounded in the verified Chen 2012 primary study (in vivo antimelanoma pharmacodynamics + surface-charge formulation ranking) and support treatment DIRECTION / RANKING qualitatively; every exact tumour volume / rate / % is NOT_REPORTED. B16 and B16-F10 records are qualitative primary-study relationships with citation NOT_REPORTED (no verified numeric extraction). B16 / B16BL6 / B16-F10 are never merged.

tum_chen_b16bl6_pd.citation: Chen Y, Zhou L, Yuan L, Zhang Z-h, Liu X, Wu Q. Int J Nanomedicine 2012;7:3023-3033. doi:10.2147/IJN.S32476 (PMC3392146)
tum_chen_b16bl6_pd.quantitative_status: NOT_REPORTED (direction only; exact PD magnitudes not extracted here)
tum_chen_b16bl6_pd.note: B16BL6 in vivo antimelanoma PD; supports treatment direction, not exact magnitude.

tum_chen_b16bl6_ranking.citation: Chen Y, et al. Int J Nanomedicine 2012;7:3023-3033. doi:10.2147/IJN.S32476
supports: cationic tripterine-NLC superior antimelanoma direction vs anionic / neutral (qualitative)
NLC formulations improved over free tripterine where reported
does_not_support: exact effect differences / percentages / tumour-volume gaps
any transfer of this ranking to B16 / B16-F10
tum_chen_b16bl6_ranking.note: Formulation ranking is B16BL6-specific; not merged into other cell models.

tum_chen_b16bl6_control.citation: Chen Y, et al. Int J Nanomedicine 2012;7:3023-3033. doi:10.2147/IJN.S32476
supports: an untreated / vehicle-control melanoma reference exists (qualitative)
tum_chen_b16bl6_control.note: Control reference for interpreting treatment relative to a compatible control.

tum_b16_growth_inhibition.citation: NOT_REPORTED (B16 celastrol antitumour primary study; qualitative relationship: growth inhibition + ROS-dependent mitochondrial apoptosis + PI3K/AKT suppression)
does_not_support: any copy of parameters into B16BL6
tum_b16_growth_inhibition.note: B16 free-celastrol; separate context; qualitative only.

tum_b16f10_growth_inhibition.citation: NOT_REPORTED (B16-F10 celastrol primary study; qualitative: reduced viability / proliferation suppression / apoptosis / cell-cycle effects, PI3K/AKT/mTOR suppression)
does_not_support: invasion / metastasis / migration burden (Phase 6D excludes these)
tum_b16f10_growth_inhibition.note: B16-F10; separate context; Phase 6D uses growth/loss/response direction only.

uncertain_differences: no human melanoma population in Profile B
tum_transfer_b16bl6_to_human_note.rationale: Documents that any human tumour-response view would be a mechanistic extrapolation, not a validated clinical claim; runtime keeps human UNAVAILABLE (population-gated).

integrity_rules.no_fabricated_quantities: No tumour volume / diameter / weight / doubling time / rate constant / % / dose is stated.
integrity_rules.experimental_direction_only: Experimental records support direction / ranking qualitatively; exact magnitudes stay NOT_REPORTED.
integrity_rules.no_cell_model_merge: B16 / B16BL6 / B16-F10 records are never combined without an explicit transfer label.
integrity_rules.no_clinical_claim: No record asserts clinical response, survival, cure, or patient outcome.
